Sensitive_nan.definition: A response indicating that an individual's skin is sensitive.

Shin_nan.definition: The front part of the leg from below the knee to the ankle.

SouthAsian_nan.definition: Denotes a person whose ancestry is in the countries of the Indian sub-continent, including India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka.

SouthEastAsian_nan.definition: Denotes a person whose ancestry is in any of the Asian countries south of China, east of India, west of New Guinea and north of Australia.

Spring_nan.definition: The season between the vernal equinox and the summer solstice.

SubgingivalPlaque_nan.definition: Plaque on teeth below the gingival margin in gingival crevice and periodontal pockets.

Summer_nan.definition: The season between the summer solstice and the autumnal equinox.

SupragingivalPlaque_nan.definition: Plaque located on teeth above the gingival margin in the gingival crevice and periodontal pockets.

Swab_nan.definition: A tuft of material on the end of a stick for applying solutions and suspensions.

Teeth_nan.definition: The hard bonelike structures in the jaws of vertebrates; primarily used for eating. Samples are taken from the surface of teeth.

Thigh_nan.definition: A part of the lower limb, located between hip and knee.

Tongue_nan.definition: The muscular organ located in the floor of the mouth and serving as the principal organ of taste and modification of the voice in speech.

TypeI_nan.definition: Skin which is extremely pale white and it always burns when exposed to the sun. It is seen in people with blond or red hair and blue or hazel eyes.

TypeII_nan.definition: Skin which is white and it usually burns easily when exposed to the sun. It is usually seen in people with blond or red hair and blue or hazel eyes.

TypeIII_nan.definition: Skin which is darker white and it sometimes burns when exposed to the sun. This type of skin can be seen in people with any hair or eye color.

TypeIV_nan.definition: Skin which is light brown and it rarely burns when exposed to the sun. It is usually seen in people of Mediterranean origin.

TypeV_nan.definition: Skin which is brown and it burns very rarely when exposed to the sun. It is usually seen in people of Middle Eastern origin.

TypeVI_nan.definition: Skin which is dark brown or black and it never burns when exposed to the sun.

Unknown_nan.definition: Not known, observed, recorded; or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

Belly_nan.definition: The front part of the human trunk below the ribs, containing the stomach and bowels

HairFibre_nan.definition: Any of the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans, mammals, and some other animals.

Metatranscriptomics_nan.definition: The study of microbe gene expression within natural environments (i.e. the metatranscriptome).

Calf_nan.definition: The back portion of the lower leg

Biofilm_nan.definition: A thin but robust layer of mucilage adhering to a solid surface and containing a community of bacteria and other microorganisms.

Palm_nan.definition: The underside of the hand between the fingers and the wrist

Forearm_nan.definition: The part of a person's arm extending from the elbow to the wrist or the fingertips

Gums_nan.definition: The tissue of the upper and lower jaws that surrounds the base of the teeth

WholeMouth_nan.definition: Pertaining to the entirity of the opening and cavity in the lower part of the human face, surrounded by the lips, through which food is taken in and vocal sounds are emitted

HairFibreEnd_nan.definition: The terminal end of any of the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans, mammals, and some other animals.

HairFibreRoot_nan.definition: The end attached to the skin of any of the fine threadlike strands growing from the skin of humans, mammals, and some other animals.

TongueScraping_nan.definition: A sample obtained by the process of running a simple tool across your tongue to remove bacteria, food particles, and other debris

PooledPlaque_nan.definition: A sticky deposit on teeth in which bacteria proliferate pooled together form multiple subjects

GloveJuice_nan.definition: The bacteria, sweat, and skin cells that accumulate under a glove worn during the sampling process

OralRinse_nan.definition: A liquid used for rinsing the mouth or gargling with.

GingivalScrapings_nan.definition: Scrapings of any plaque and tartar that's developed anywhere around your gum line

BuccalMucosaScrapings_nan.definition: Scrapings from the epithelium lining the inner surface of the cheeks and lips from the line of contact of the opposing lips

HairCutting_nan.definition: A sample obtained through the cutting of hair fibre from a seleced body site.

Combination_nan.definition: A skin condition which features two or more different skin types on the face, and the condition of your skin may fluctuate between seasons.

DermalMelasma_nan.definition: Categorical measure of dermal melasma (where melanin is in the deeper layers of the skin).

EpidermalMelasma_nan.definition: Categorical measure of epidermal melasma (where melanin is in the more superficial layers of the skin).

MixedMelasma_nan.definition: Categorical measure of the combination of dermal and epidermal melasma.

Whole Genome Sequencing_nan.definition: A procedure that can determine the DNA sequence for nearly the entire genome of an individual.

RNA Sequencing_nan.definition: An assay that determines the sequence of an RNA molecule.

Variant Calling_nan.definition: Detect, identify and map mutations, such as single nucleotide polymorphisms, short indels and structural variants, in multiple DNA sequences. Typically the alignment and comparison of the fluorescent traces produced by DNA sequencing hardware, to study genomic alterations.

Flow Cytometry_nan.definition: A technique for counting, examining and sorting microscopic particles suspended in a stream of fluid.

Mass Spectrometry_nan.definition: An analytical technique wherein ions are separated according to their ratio of charge to mass. From the mass spectrum produced, the atomic weight of the particle can be deduced.

Microarray_nan.definition: Analysis using microarray technology (e.g., cDNA arrays to see gene expression or protein microarrays to profile the pattern of proteins).

Genomics_nan.definition: The study of comprehensive sets of genes via high throughput methods.

Transcriptomics_nan.definition: The analysis of transcriptomes, or a set of all the RNA molecules in a specific cell, tissue etc.

Metabolomics_nan.definition: The systematic study of metabolites, the chemical processes they are involved, and the chemical fingerprints of specific cellular processes in a whole cell, tissue, organ or organism.

Lipidomics_nan.definition: A study of the complete set of lipids produced in a given cell or organism under specific conditions.

Proteomics_nan.definition: The global analysis of cellular proteins. Proteomics uses a combination of sophisticated techniques including two-dimensional (2D) gel electrophoresis, image analysis, mass spectrometry, amino acid sequencing, and bio-informatics to resolve comprehensively, to quantify, and to characterize proteins. The application of proteomics provides major opportunities to elucidate disease mechanisms and to identify new diagnostic markers and therapeutic targets.

Epigenetics_nan.definition: Epigenetics is the study of the chemical modification of specific genes or gene-associated proteins of an organism.

FabricSwatch_nan.alt_definition: Swatch of fabric placed inside a T-shirt that is worn by a consumer to measure skin microbiome that is transferred to the swatch.

Vagina_nan.definition: The female genital canal, extending from the uterus to the vulva.
Vagina_nan.alt_definition: The muscular tube leading from the external genitals to the cervix of the uterus in women and most female mammals

HighVagina_nan.alt_definition: A high vaginal swab is a medical procedure performed in obstetrics and gynaecology to test vaginal discharge for the presence of vaginal thrush, bacterial vaginosis and trichomonas vaginalis.

VulvoVagina_nan.alt_definition: A sample taken from or relating to the external female genitals

Ichthyosis_nan.definition: A group of inherited or acquired skin disorders characterized by a dry, thickened, and scaly skin. The skin changes range from mild to severe.
Ichthyosis_nan.alt_definition: A group of skin disorders that lead to dry, itchy skin that appears scaly, rough, and red.

Lamellar Ichthyosis_nan.definition: A very rare, autosomal recessive inherited skin disorder present at birth. It is characterized by the presence of a transparent membrane encasing the newborn. This membrane sheds in about two weeks after birth to reveal generalized scaling and skin erythema.
Lamellar Ichthyosis_nan.alt_definition: People with lamellar ichthyosis typically have large, dark, plate-like scales covering their skin on most of their body.

Epidermolytic Ichthyosis_nan.definition: An autosomal dominant inherited skin disorder caused by mutations in the KRT1 and KRT10 genes. It is manifested at birth and is characterized by generalized erythema, skin blisters and skin fragility.
Epidermolytic Ichthyosis_nan.alt_definition: Epidermolytic ichthyosis (bullous ichthyosiform erythroderma) is a rare autosomal dominant disorder of cornification caused by mutations in keratins 1 and 10

Congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma_na.definition: An ichthyosiform abnormality of the skin with congenital onset.
Congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma_na.alt_definition: This is an extremely rare skin disorder characterised by abnormal scaling of the skin with underlying redness.

Infant Feeding_nan.definition: Type of study where feeding effects on infants are anaylsed.

Cesarean Section_nan.definition: Surgical delivery of one or more intrauterine fetuses though an abdominal incision

Vaginal Delivery_nan.definition: Birth of the fetus through the vagina

Placebo_nan.definition: An inactive substance, treatment or procedure that is intended to provide baseline measurements for the experimental protocol of a clinical trial.

Active Comparator_nan.definition: A therapeutically active agent, treatment regimen or procedure that is intended to provide baseline measurements for the experimental protocol of a clinical trial

Study Control_nan.definition: A comparator treatment in a clinical trial against which the treatment under study is evaluated.
